Step 1: 17 weeks + 6 days = 17 × 7 + 6 = 119 + 6 = 125 days.  
Step 2: 01-04-1402 is April 1, 1402 (dd-mm-yyyy).  
Step 3: Add 125 days: April has 30 days → from Apr 1: +29 days → Apr 30, then May 31 days → +31 → May 31, then June 30 days → +30 → June 30, then July 31 days → +31 → July 31, then August 1 day left (125 - 29 - 31 - 30 - 31 = 4 days into August) → Aug 4, 1402.  
Step 4: Check leap year: 1402 not divisible by 4 → not leap year, so February unaffected.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1402-08-04
